title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Dev Ops Engineer
- Clever Tap Dev Ops Engineer Job type: Full Time · Department: Engineering · Work type: On-Site Mumbai, Maharashtra, India Job details Application form About the

ROLE:
As a Devops Engineer you will maintain, manage and improve day-to-day operations that keep our platform secure and available What will you do:
- Execute standard operating procedures designed to ensure platform security and availability
- Recommend and implement improvements towards standard operating procedures
- Execute planned stories where the implementation is straightforward
- Participate in platform architecture development discussions
- Work with members from rest of the engineering team and customer success
- Work with vendor support teams to solve issues What are we looking for? Must have:
- BS / MS degree in computer science from premier institutes with top grades or equivalent practical experience.
- 1 to 3 years of experience working into Dev Ops.
- Experience or working knowledge of provisioning and managing infrastructure as code with Cloud Formation or Terraform in production
- Experience of being on call schedule to support production
- Experience or working knowledge of packaging and deploying application with docker using ECS or Kubernetes Good to Have:
- Proficient in one coding language prefereblily Golang or Java
- AWS Devops Certification Who will you report to: Team Lead Dev Ops Why join us:
- Contribute to a product backed by 11 technology patents, showcasing industry-leading innovation.
- You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high-growth mobile technology space
- Power personalized engagement at scale, processing over 30 billion events daily and reaching 3+ billion devices worldwide.
- Work with the smartest people who built software impacting billions of people
- Work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contribution matters Learn More Get to know us better before you apply! title: Senior Manager - Deal Desk and Order to Cash
jobDescription:
Senior Manager
- Deal Desk and Order to Cash
- Clever Tap Senior Manager
- Deal Desk and Order to Cash Job type: Full Time · Department: Finance · Work type: On-Site Mumbai, Maharashtra, India Job details Application form About the

ROLE:
In this role you will act as the Finance counterpart to Sales and the CRO office, you will own pricing governance on every non-standard deal and drive end-to-end receivables recovery across our global entities. You'll manage a growing collections portfolio, build Clever Tap's deal desk playbook from the ground up, and lead a direct report from day one. What will you do: Strategic Business Partnering Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations leaders to drive strategic business decisions. Translate financial insights into actionable recommendations that improve business performance. Support annual planning, budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning. Commercial Finance & Deal Desk Lead the Deal Desk process by reviewing complex commercial deals, pricing, discount structures, payment terms, and contract profitability. Partner with Sales, Legal, and Revenue Operations to ensure deals align with company policies and financial objectives. Provide financial guidance on large enterprise transactions and strategic customer negotiations. Analyze revenue performance, pipeline conversion, operating expenses, and key Saa S metrics. Revenue & Collections Partner with Accounting and Accounts Receivable teams to improve collections, reduce outstanding receivables, and strengthen cash flow. Monitor customer payment trends and recommend actions to improve working capital. Track bookings, billings, ARR, revenue realization, and cash collections. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to automate and improve financial reporting and commercial workflows. Partner with Finance Systems and Revenue Operations to optimize quote-to-cash processes. Drive scalable financial controls and governance as the business grows. Order to Cash Own subscription + usage/overage billing accuracy across the billing platform and Net Suite Drive AR aging reduction and DSO improvement across India/APAC and NAM/EMEA/LATAM books separately Own revenue recognition compliance (Ind AS 115/ASC 606) for subscription and overage revenue streams Manage regional collections escalation, credit hold policy, and dispute resolution Maintain and evolve the AR movement tracker and regional action-item process Coordinate with Legal on contract terms affecting billing (payment terms, usage caps, renewal timing) Partner with Tax on withholding tax deductions embedded in cross-border collections What are we looking for? Must Have: 4 to 6 years of experience in Commercial Finance, Business Finance, or Strategic Finance. Experience partnering with Deal Desk, Sales Operations, or Revenue Operations teams. Strong understanding of Saa S business models, subscription revenue, ARR, bookings, renewals, and revenue recognition. Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Good to have: Knowledge of collections, accounts receivable, and working capital management. Familiarity with Saa S metrics including ARR, MRR, NRR, CAC, LTV, pipeline conversion, and gross margin. Who will you report to: Associate Director
